label: cache
user_extra: store.aura MUST define (cache-init) and (cache-set key val ttl). ops.aura MUST define (cache-get key) and (cache-tick n). Tick model: global tick; ttl=0 means forever (#f expire); ttl>0 stores expire-tick=tick+ttl; cache-tick advances tick; expired get returns miss. main.aura MUST call cache-init, cache-set a/1/0, cache-set b/2/2, four cache-gets (a, nope, b, b-after-tick-2), cache-tick 2, and print COUNT= non-miss gets among those four (expect 2). Named fences required for store.aura, ops.aura, main.aura in that order. Aura run: `aura store.aura ops.aura main.aura`.
